title: Adic finiteness for a projective-space projection
statement: Fix a prime l. For a scheme V let Qbar_l,V be the sheaf of locally finite continuous functions to an algebraic closure of Q_l: locally on V the values lie in a finite extension of Q_l. Let AdicSheaf_l(V) be the abelian category of modules over this sheaf, and call such a sheaf constructible if Zariski locally it admits a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes on which it is pro-etale locally finite free. These are the concrete sheaf models of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Write D^b_c(V) for the objects of the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] which are bounded for its standard t-structure and have constructible cohomology. Let l be a prime and K an algebraically closed field with char K != l. Let W be affine and t:W -> Spec K locally of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let n be any finite type (possibly empty) and let p:P(Option n; W) -> W be relative projective space [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], of fibre dimension the cardinality of n. For a constructible adic sheaf F on this projective space, Rp_*(F[0]) belongs to D^b_c(W).

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2, Proposition 6.8.11, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; affine compactification proof of sk-prop-sf-finiteness (SGA 4½, Theoreme de finitude, Theorem 1.1).

proof.text: The affine base W, locally of finite type over a field, is Noetherian. The projective-space projection p is proper and locally of finite type, and its source is Noetherian. Place F in degree zero: its sole nonzero cohomology is F, so F[0] is bounded with constructible cohomology. This uses the proved elementary singleFunctor lemma in Adic.ConstructibleHeart, not any constructible t-structure existence assertion.

Use encoding_exact_derived from the native encoding interface to obtain exactness. Its derived homology comparison and [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-constructibility] show that the encoded F[0] is bounded constructible for the pulled-back bounded-image condensed algebraic closure coefficient.

Apply the existing proper direct-image finiteness theorem [lem-sfb-proper-dc-preserves-qbar] to p over K, with Fact (ringChar K != l) supplied by hK. It gives bounded constructibility of the condensed derived direct image.

The derivedPushComparison of [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-ordinary-operations] identifies this image with the encoding of the native Rp_*F[0]. Transport boundedness and each constructible cohomology along this isomorphism. Exactness and faithfulness of encoding reflect boundedness; the derived homology comparison and [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-constructibility] reflect constructible cohomology. The isomorphism invariance used here is the proved helper constructible_of_iso in [lem-weil-pbc-module-constructible-pullback]. The conclusion is precisely the original conjunction. No positive-rank, nonempty-base, or positive-dimensional projective-space assumption was used.

proof_origin.place: Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.8; Remark 6.8.15. Reuse the existing condensed proper direct-image finiteness theorem and transport through the normalized native encoding.

    (hK : ringChar K ≠ l) {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine W]
    (t : W ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType t] (n : Type u) [Finite n]
    (F : AdicSheaf l ℙ(Option n; W)) (hF : IsAdicConstructibleSheaf F) :

      _root_.DerivedCategory.homologyProperty (adicConstructibleSheaf l W))
